verses.original: ט֤וֹב חֲ֭רֵבָה פַּ֣ת וְשַׁלְוָה־ בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי־ רִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ ḥă·rê·ḇāh paṯ wə·šal·wāh- ḇāh mib·ba·yiṯ mā·lê ziḇ·ḥê- rîḇ
verses.literal: Better a dry morsel in quietness than a house full of feasting with strife

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל עֶֽבֶד־ יִ֭מְשֹׁל מֵבִ֑ישׁ בְּבֵ֣ן יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה׃ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: maś·kîl ‘e·ḇeḏ- yim·šōl mê·ḇîš bə·ḇên ya·ḥă·lōq na·ḥă·lāh ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ ’a·ḥîm
verses.literal: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share his inheritance as one of the brothers

verses.original: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב יְהוָֽה׃ וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: maṣ·rêp̄ lak·ke·sep̄ wə·ḵūr laz·zā·hāḇ Yah·weh ū·ḇō·ḥên lib·bō·wṯ
verses.literal: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold but the LORD is the tester of hearts

verses.original: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־ אָ֑וֶן שְׂפַת־ שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל־ הַוֺּֽת׃ לְשׁ֥וֹן
verses.transliteration: mê·ra‘ maq·šîḇ ‘al- ’ā·wen śə·p̄aṯ- še·qer mê·zîn ‘al- haw·wōṯ lə·šō·wn
verses.literal: A wicked man listens to evil lips a liar gives ear to a destructive tongue

verses.original: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō·‘êḡ lā·rāš ḥê·rêp̄ ‘ō·śê·hū śā·mê·aḥ lə·’êḏ lō yin·nā·qeh
verses.literal: He who mocks the poor insults their Maker whoever gloats over calamity will not go unpunished

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḇā·nîm ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ zə·qê·nîm wə·ṯip̄·’e·reṯ bā·nîm ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Grandchildren . . . are the crown of the aged and the glory of a son is his father

verses.original: יֶ֑תֶר שְׂפַת־ לֹא־ נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ שָֽׁקֶר׃ שְׂפַת־ לְנָדִ֥יב
verses.transliteration: ye·ṯer śə·p̄aṯ- lō- nā·wāh lə·nā·ḇāl ’ap̄ kî- šā·qer śə·p̄aṯ- lə·nā·ḏîḇ
verses.literal: Eloquent words are unfit . . . for a fool how much worse . . . are lying lips to a ruler

verses.original: הַ֭שֹּׁחַד חֵ֣ן אֶֽבֶן־ בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·ḥaḏ ḥên ’e·ḇen- bə·‘ê·nê ḇə·‘ā·lāw ’el- kāl- ’ă·šer yip̄·neh yaś·kîl
verses.literal: A bribe is a charm . . . to its giver wherever . . . - he turns he succeeds

verses.original: מְֽכַסֶּה־ פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḵas·seh- pe·ša‘ mə·ḇaq·qêš ’a·hă·ḇāh wə·šō·neh ḇə·ḏā·ḇār map̄·rîḏ ’al·lūp̄
verses.literal: Whoever conceals an offense promotes love but he who brings it up . . . separates friends

verses.original: גְּעָרָ֣ה תֵּ֣חַת בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵאָֽה׃ מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל
verses.transliteration: gə·‘ā·rāh tê·ḥaṯ ḇə·mê·ḇîn mê·’āh mê·hak·kō·wṯ kə·sîl
verses.literal: A rebuke cuts into a man of discernment deeper than a hundred lashes [cut into] a fool

verses.original: רָ֑ע יְבַקֶּשׁ־ אַךְ־ מְרִ֥י אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ יְשֻׁלַּח־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: rā‘ yə·ḇaq·qeš- ’aḵ- mə·rî ’aḵ·zā·rî ū·mal·’āḵ yə·šul·laḥ- bōw
verses.literal: An evil [man] seeks only rebellion a cruel messenger will be sent against him

verses.original: בְּאִ֑ישׁ פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל וְאַל־ כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’îš pā·ḡō·wōš dōḇ šak·kūl wə·’al- kə·sîl bə·’iw·wal·tōw
verses.literal: [It is better] to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה רָ֝עָ֗ה לֹא־ תָמִישׁ מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·šîḇ rā·‘āh ta·ḥaṯ ṭō·w·ḇāh rā·‘āh lō- ṯå̄·mīš mib·bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: If anyone returns evil for good evil will never leave his house

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם נְטֽוֹשׁ׃ הָרִ֥יב וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע
verses.transliteration: rê·šîṯ mā·ḏō·wn pō·w·ṭêr ma·yim nə·ṭō·wōš hā·rîḇ wə·lip̄·nê hiṯ·gal·la‘
verses.literal: To start a quarrel is to release a flood so abandon the dispute before it breaks out

verses.original: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃ תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־
verses.transliteration: maṣ·dîq rā·šā‘ ū·mar·šî·a‘ ṣad·dîq šə·nê·hem tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh gam-
verses.literal: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous both are detestable to the LORD -

verses.original: לָמָּה־ זֶּ֣ה כְּסִ֑יל מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד־ אָֽיִן׃ וְלֶב־ לִקְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- zeh kə·sîl mə·ḥîr bə·yaḏ- ’ā·yin wə·leḇ- liq·nō·wṯ ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: Why . . . should the fool have money in his hand with no intention of buying wisdom

verses.original: הָרֵ֑עַ אֹהֵ֣ב בְּכָל־ עֵ֭ת וְאָ֥ח יִוָּלֵֽד׃ לְ֝צָרָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: hā·rê·a‘ ’ō·hêḇ bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ wə·’āḥ yiw·wā·lêḏ lə·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: A friend loves at all times and a brother is born for adversity

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר־ לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִפְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām ḥă·sar- lêḇ tō·w·qê·a‘ kāp̄ ‘ō·rêḇ ‘ă·rub·bāh lip̄·nê rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: A man lacking judgment strikes hands in pledge and puts up security . . . for his neighbor

verses.original: אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה פִּ֝תְח֗וֹ מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ מְבַקֶּשׁ־ שָֽׁבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ pe·ša‘ ’ō·hêḇ maṣ·ṣāh piṯ·ḥōw maḡ·bî·ah mə·ḇaq·qeš- šā·ḇer
verses.literal: He who loves transgression loves strife he who builds his gate high invites destruction

verses.original: עִקֶּשׁ־ לֵ֭ב יִמְצָא־ לֹ֣א ט֑וֹב בִּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ וְנֶהְפָּ֥ךְ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘iq·qeš- lêḇ yim·ṣā- lō ṭō·wḇ bil·šō·w·nōw wə·neh·pāḵ yip·pō·wl bə·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: The one with a perverse heart finds no good and he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble

verses.original: יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְת֣וּגָה ל֑וֹ אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל׃ וְלֹֽא־ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח
verses.transliteration: yō·lêḏ kə·sîl lə·ṯū·ḡāh lōw ’ă·ḇî nā·ḇāl wə·lō- yiś·maḥ
verses.literal: A man fathers a fool to his own grief the father of a fool has no joy

verses.original: שָׂ֭מֵחַ לֵ֣ב יֵיטִ֣ב גֵּהָ֑ה נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה וְר֥וּחַ תְּיַבֶּשׁ־ גָּֽרֶם׃
verses.transliteration: śā·mē·aḥ lêḇ yê·ṭiḇ gê·hāh nə·ḵê·’āh wə·rū·aḥ tə·yab·beš- gā·rem
verses.literal: A joyful heart is good medicine but a broken spirit dries up the bones

verses.original: רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח מֵ֭חֵיק שֹׁ֣חַד לְ֝הַטּ֗וֹת אָרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: rā·šā‘ yiq·qāḥ mê·ḥêq šō·ḥaḏ lə·haṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: A wicked [man] takes a covert bribe to subvert the course of justice

verses.original: חָכְמָ֑ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין וְעֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּקְצֵה־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥāḵ·māh ’eṯ- pə·nê mê·ḇîn wə·‘ê·nê ḵə·sîl biq·ṣêh- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Wisdom vvv is the focus of the discerning but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth

verses.original: כְּסִ֑יל בֵּ֣ן כַּ֣עַס לְ֭אָבִיו וּ֝מֶ֗מֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·sîl bên ka·‘as lə·’ā·ḇîw ū·me·mer lə·yō·w·laḏ·tōw
verses.literal: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to her who bore him

verses.original: גַּ֤ם לֹא־ ט֑וֹב עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַצַּדִּ֣יק לְהַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל־ יֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.transliteration: gam lō- ṭō·wḇ ‘ă·nō·wōš laṣ·ṣad·dîq lə·hak·kō·wṯ nə·ḏî·ḇîm ‘al- yō·šer
verses.literal: It is surely not good to punish the innocent or to flog a noble for his honesty

verses.original: יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָיו אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃ וְקַר ר֝֗וּחַ
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏê·a‘ dā·‘aṯ ḥō·w·śêḵ ’ă·mā·rāw ’îš tə·ḇū·nāh wə·qar
verses.literal: A man of knowledge . . . restrains his words and a man of understanding maintains a calm spirit

verses.original: גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב חָכָ֣ם מַ֭חֲרִישׁ נָבֽוֹן׃ אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: gam ’ĕ·wîl yê·ḥā·šêḇ ḥā·ḵām ma·ḥă·rîš nā·ḇō·wn ’ō·ṭêm śə·p̄ā·ṯāw
verses.literal: Even a fool is considered wise if he keeps silent [and] discerning when he holds his tongue
